primaryWitness.zh: 十一，隨外祖於朱雀航賣曆日。
primaryWitness.literalEn: At eleven he followed his maternal grandfather to sell almanacs at the Zhuque ferry.
primaryWitness.idiomaticEn: At eleven he helped his maternal grandfather sell almanacs at the Zhuque ferry.
primaryWitness.analysis: The line attests Fu Zhao (p019) at age eleven with his maternal grandfather (外祖) at Zhuque ferry; it does not name or describe a mother. 傅昭母 is an editorial compound not present in the Chinese. Maternal-line kinship may be structurally inferred for graph bookkeeping, but it is not a quotable named-person identity under primary-witness rules.

surroundingContext.zh: 祖和之，父淡，善《三禮》，知名宋世。
昭六歲而孤，哀毀如成人者，宗黨咸異之。

primaryWitness.idiomaticEn: He was orphaned at the age of three.
primaryWitness.analysis: s0100 follows s0099 (映字徽遠，昭弟也) and records Fu Ying's orphanhood. 孤 supports a deceased parent context but does not surface 父 or any personal name. It cannot witness a named father record or the invented surface 傅昭映父.

correctiveWitness.zh: 祖和之，父淡，善《三禮》，知名宋世。
correctiveWitness.analysis: In Fu Zhao's biography, the historian explicitly names his father 淡 (Fu Dan, sealed local person p022). The same Fu Zhao (p043) and younger brother Fu Ying (p048, s0099 昭弟) share this paternal line. Father identity should anchor on s0042 via p022, not on s0100.
